name: twincat-automation
description: TwinCAT 3 IDE automation and PLC runtime control

tools.name: ConnectIde
tools.description: Connect to a running TwinCAT XAE / Visual Studio instance (found through the Running Object Table); only if none is found does it launch a new XAE.

ProgId.description: COM ProgID to connect to / launch.

NoLaunch.description: If set, do not launch a new IDE instance if none is running.

LaunchIfBlocked.description: With -SolutionPath: ignore a blocked IDE that matches only by window title (matchedBy 'window-title', i.e. a same-named solution that may be someone else's) and go on as if it were not there (launch unless -NoLaunch).

tools.name: DisconnectIde
tools.description: Release the DTE/COM references held by the bridge.

Quit.description: true = also close the solution (without saving) and quit the IDE.

Kill.description: Only with Quit=true: kill the IDE process when it cannot be quit (modal dialog, DTE.Quit failed).

tools.name: ResetSolution
tools.description: Reload every project file from disk: dismisses the reload prompt if it is up (data.dismissedReloadPrompt).

TimeoutSec.description: Expected upper bound for each of Documents.CloseAll, Solution.Close and Solution.Open, and the total time Solution.FullName is polled in one call (wait after a Yes reload, solution check), in seconds (default 120).

DiscardProjectChanges.description: true = keep the disk version: skip the project file check and close without saving even when PLC objects in XAE are missing from the .plcproj on disk (they are dropped).

SaveProjectChanges.description: true = keep the XAE version: objects in XAE that the .plcproj on disk does not list are saved (project files only) before closing.

tools.name: GetIdeInfo
tools.description: Return version, edition, open solution, ITcSysManager availability and the active solution platform / configuration (solutionPlatform, solutionConfiguration; null when unreadable) of the connected IDE.

tools.name: GetIdeModalDialog
tools.description: Report the modal dialog blocking the IDE (data.scanComplete true + data.dialog null when none; an unfinished scan is MODAL_SCAN_INCOMPLETE, unknown, not none). Works while DTE calls fail with IDE_BUSY. On MCP this is a composite tool.

ProcessId.description: IDE process id (default: the connected IDE)

tools.name: GetAutomationVersion
tools.description: Read-only and offline: which TwinCATAutomation this server runs (#30).

Verify.description: Also compare the installed files with the SHA256 hashes recorded in the install manifest (detects an accidental or partial change of the installed copy).

tools.name: NewProject
tools.description: Create new TwinCAT project with PLC and MAIN program. #70: only on an IDE with no solution open (otherwise SOLUTION_ALREADY_OPEN, nothing created); not offered on the MCP server.

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.description: Open a solution (.sln) in the connected IDE and wait until the TwinCAT project is loaded.

tools.name: GetProjectTree
tools.description: Read the project tree.

Depth.description: Levels below each root node (1-10, default 4). 4 reaches the POUs: TIPC(0)^<Plc>(1)^<Plc> Project(2)^POUs(3)^<POU>(4).

PlcOnly.description: true = return only the TIPC (PLC) subtree.

tools.name: AddPou
tools.description: Create a POU (Program, FunctionBlock or Function, language ST) in <Plc> Project^POUs (or PlcProjectPath) and read it back: success only when the new item is found with the expected kind. data: path, folderPath, objectKind (POU), itemType (602 Program / 603 Function / 604 FunctionBlock), language...

Type.description: POU type: Program, FunctionBlock, or Function.

ReturnType.description: Return type for Functions (e.g., INT, BOOL).

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path of the folder the POU is created in, e.g. TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs (same on 4024 and 4026).

tools.name: AddGvl
tools.description: Create a GVL in <Plc> Project^GVLs, write VAR_GLOBAL ... END_VAR from Variables and read it back.

Variables.description: Variables in declaration order (array; the order is kept and verified on readback, #47): [{"name":"bStart","type":"BOOL"},{"name":"nCount","type":"INT","init":"0","comment":"counter"}] (name and type required).

tools.name: AddDut
tools.description: Create a DUT (Struct / Enum / Union / Alias) in <Plc> Project^DUTs, write its declaration (TYPE ... END_TYPE from Fields / AliasType; an Enum without Fields gets enum_member := 0) and read it back.

DutType.description: DUT type: Struct, Enum, Alias, Union.

Fields.description: Members in declaration order (array; the order is kept and verified on readback, #47).

tools.name: AddLibrary
tools.description: Add a library reference to the PLC project: ITcPlcLibraryManager.AddLibrary(Name, Version, Vendor) on TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^References (TE1000 6.5.14).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project).

tools.name: AddInterface
tools.description: Create an INTERFACE (CreateChild 618, TE1000 v1.7.0 6.5.5) in <Plc> Project^POUs (or PlcProjectPath) and read it back: the declaration must be INTERFACE <Name> (EXTENDS <Extends> when given).

Extends.description: Optional interface it extends, as one string (e.g. I_Base; several: 'I_A, I_B' is passed as given, not measured).

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path of the folder the interface is created in, e.g. TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs (same as AddPou PlcProjectPath).

tools.name: AddPouMember
tools.description: Add a Method, Property, Action, or a property Get / Set accessor below a PROGRAM / FUNCTION_BLOCK / INTERFACE (Get / Set: below a property) and read it back (CreateChild, TE1000 v1.7.0 6.5.5).

ParentPath.description: The POU, interface or property that gets the member: a full tree path (TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^FB_Motor, ...^FB_Motor^P_Speed for Get / Set) or a name as for Get-TcPouCode -PouName (FB_Motor, FB_Motor.P_Speed).

Kind.description: Method, Property, Action, Get or Set.

ReturnType.description: Method: return type (optional; none = a method without return type).

Access.description: PUBLIC (default), PRIVATE, PROTECTED or INTERNAL (TE1000 6.5.5 p.231).

Language.description: Implementation language of a method / action / accessor: ST (default), IL, SFC, FBD, CFC or LD.

tools.name: GetLibraries
tools.description: Lists the library references and placeholders of a PLC project, or with -Repository the libraries installed on this machine.

Repository.description: List the libraries installed on this machine (ScanLibraries) instead of the project references.

Filter.description: Wildcard on the name (-like, case-insensitive), e.g. 'Tc2_*'.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS). -Repository needs a PLC project too (the Library Manager lives on its References node).

tools.name: AddPlaceholder
tools.description: Adds a library placeholder to the PLC project (ITcPlcLibraryManager.AddPlaceholder), saves the project file and reads it back.

Placeholder.description: Placeholder name, with or without the leading '#'.

LibraryName.description: Default library of the placeholder (e.g. Tc2_Math).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: RemoveReference
tools.description: Removes a library reference or placeholder from the PLC project (ITcPlcLibraryManager.RemoveReference). Dry-run by default.

Name.description: Library or placeholder name, with or without the leading '#' (e.g. Tc2_Math or #Tc2_Math).

Kind.description: Library or Placeholder: which reference -Name means.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be removed. false: back up, remove, read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: InstallLibrary
tools.description: Installs a .library / .compiled-library file into a library repository of this machine (ITcPlcLibraryManager.InstallLibrary). Dry-run by default.

LibraryPath.description: Absolute path of the .library or .compiled-library file.

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report. false: install and read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (the Library Manager lives on its References node).

tools.name: UninstallLibrary
tools.description: Removes one library version from a library repository of this machine (ITcPlcLibraryManager.UninstallLibrary). Dry-run by default.

LibraryName.description: Library name exactly as ScanLibraries lists it (Get-TcLibraries -Repository), e.g. Tc2_Math.

Distributor.description: Exact distributor, e.g. Beckhoff Automation GmbH.

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report. false: uninstall and read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (the Library Manager lives on its References node).

tools.name: FreezePlaceholder
tools.description: Freezes one library placeholder (or all with -All) to its current version (ITcPlcLibraryManager.FreezePlaceholder). Dry-run by default.

Placeholder.description: Placeholder to freeze, with or without the leading '#'.

All.description: Freeze every placeholder (FreezePlaceholder with an empty name).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report. false: back up, freeze, save and read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: AddPlcTask
tools.description: Adds a PLC task: a real-time task TIRT^<Name> with CycleTimeUs / Priority plus the PLC task object '<Plc> Project^<Name>' linked to it. Dry-run by default.

Name.description: Task name, used for the TIRT task and the PLC task object (e.g. FastTask).

CycleTimeUs.description: Cycle time in microseconds (> 0), e.g. 1000 = 1 ms.

Priority.description: Optional task priority (TaskDef/Priority); XAE's default is kept when omitted.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report the plan. false: create, set, read back.

tools.name: LinkProgramToTask
tools.description: Links a PROGRAM to a PLC task (CreateChild 650 below '<Plc> Project^<PlcTask>'). Dry-run by default.

ProgramName.description: Name of the PROGRAM, exactly as declared (e.g. MAIN).

PlcTask.description: Name of the PLC task below '<Plc> Project' (default PlcTask).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report the plan. false: back up, create, read back.

tools.name: UnlinkProgramFromTask
tools.description: Removes a program call from a PLC task (DeleteChild of the 650 child of '<Plc> Project^<PlcTask>'). Dry-run by default.

ProgramName.description: Name of the program call to remove, exactly as listed below the task.

PlcTask.description: Name of the PLC task below '<Plc> Project' (default PlcTask).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be removed. false: back up, remove, read back.

tools.name: ExportPlcOpen
tools.description: Exports PLC objects (or the whole PLC project) to a PLCopen XML file (PlcOpenExport on '<Plc> Project'); does not change the project.

Selection.description: Objects or folders relative to '<Plc> Project', one per element, '.' between folder levels; the first level is a folder of the PLC project, e.g. 'AxisInterface.LIB.AxisControl.FB_AxisControl' (the string measured 2026-10-31) or 'POUs.FB_A'.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the PLCopen XML file to write (e.g. C:\Temp\export.xml); its folder must exist.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

Overwrite.description: Replace an existing file: it is renamed to '<FilePath>.bak' first and put back when the export fails.

tools.name: ImportPlcOpen
tools.description: Imports a PLCopen XML file into the PLC project (PlcOpenImport on '<Plc> Project'). Dry-run by default.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the PLCopen XML file to import (e.g. written by Export-TcPlcOpen).

Option.description: What happens with an object that already exists: None (default; a conflict fails, nothing is imported), Replace (the existing object is replaced, children the file lacks are deleted; backed up first), Rename (the imported object gets '_1...

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

DryRun.description: Default true: only parse, compare and report. false: back up (Replace), import, read back.

tools.name: SaveAsLibrary
tools.description: Saves the PLC project as a library file (.library / .compiled-library) with SaveAsLibrary(path, $false): the library is NOT installed.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the library file to write, ending in .library or .compiled-library.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

Overwrite.description: Replace an existing file: it is renamed to '<FilePath>.bak' first and put back when saving fails.

tools.name: SaveArchive
tools.description: Saves the open solution (.tnzip) or the TwinCAT configuration (.tszip) as an archive of the state in XAE memory; checks the Error List, because a missing component is only reported there.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the archive to write: .tnzip for -Kind Solution, .tszip for -Kind Configuration.

Overwrite.description: Replace an existing file: it is renamed to '<FilePath>.bak' first and put back when saving fails.

tools.name: WritePouCode
tools.description: Write Declaration and/or Implementation of an existing PLC object through the XAE edit buffer (no ResetSolution needed).

PouName.description: Name of the POU to write to.

Implementation.description: Structured Text implementation section (code body). -Implementation '' clears the body: ImplementationText = '' is written and must read back empty (measured 2026-10-31, 4026 VS2022, self-built client: COM ImplementationText = '' on a me...

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4 -> Parent.Member, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy).

tools.name: GetPouCode
tools.description: Read the source of a PLC object: POU, DUT, GVL, interface, method ... data.objectKind (POU / DUT / GVL / ITF / METHOD / ACTION / PROPERTY_GET / ... / UNKNOWN, from the tree item ItemType; data.itemType, data.itemTypeName), data.pouType (Program / Function / FunctionBlock for a POU, Struct / Enum...

PouName.description: Name of the POU to read.

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4 -> Parent.Member, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy).

tools.name: IoScan
tools.description: Scan the I/O devices of the target (ProduceXml(false) on TIID, TE1000 6.6.2).

Apply.description: Add the found devices to the I/O tree (CreateChild + AddressInfo + ScanBoxes) and read them back.

tools.name: GetIoTree
tools.description: Reads the current I/O device tree (TIID subtree) and returns as JSON.

tools.name: SetVariableLink
tools.description: Links a PLC variable to an I/O variable (ITcSysManager.LinkVariables) and reads the mapping back.

PlcVariable.description: Full tree path of the PLC variable, e.g. "TIPC^MyPlc^MyPlc Instance^PlcTask Inputs^MAIN.bIn".

IoChannel.description: Full tree path of the I/O variable, e.g. "TIID^EtherCAT Master^Term 1 (EK1100)^Term 2 (EL1004)^Channel 1^Input".

tools.name: RemoveVariableLink
tools.description: Removes the link between a PLC variable and an I/O variable (ITcSysManager.UnlinkVariables) and reads the mapping back.

PlcVariable.description: Full tree path of the PLC variable, e.g. "TIPC^MyPlc^MyPlc Instance^PlcTask Inputs^MAIN.bIn".

IoChannel.description: Full tree path of the I/O variable.

tools.name: AddNcTask
tools.description: Adds the NC task below TINC (CreateChild SubType 1); a TINC holds only one, so an existing task returns NC_TASK_ALREADY_EXISTS. Dry-run by default.

Name.description: Requested task name (default 'NC-Task 1'; XAE may append ' SAF').

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report the plan. false: create and read back.

tools.name: AddNcAxis
tools.description: Adds an NC axis below '<NC task>^Axes' (CreateChild) and reads back that it is a simulation axis (encoder = Simulation encoder). Dry-run by default.

Task.description: NC task name or tree path (TINC^NC-Task 1 SAF); default: the only NC task.

AxisType.description: Continuous (default), Discrete, Stepper or Encoder; fixed at creation (ConsumeXml AxisType does not change it, measured).

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report the plan. false: create and read back.

tools.name: SetNcAxisParameter
tools.description: Sets measured NC axis fields (max velocity, acceleration, deceleration, jerk, encoder / drive / controller type) with ConsumeXml and reads every field back. Dry-run by default.

Axis.description: Axis name or tree path (TINC^NC-Task 1 SAF^Axes^Axis 1).

ControllerType.description: Controller/CtrType number (1 = Position controller P, the default).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the planned change. false: back up, write, read back.

tools.name: LinkNcAxis
tools.description: Links an NC axis to a PLC AXIS_REF (two struct links: NcToPlc <-> Outputs^ToPlc, PlcToNc <-> Inputs^FromPlc) and reads the mapping back. Dry-run by default.

Axis.description: Axis name or tree path (TINC^NC-Task 1 SAF^Axes^Axis 1).

PlcVariable.description: Symbol of the PLC AXIS_REF (AT %I* / %Q* members NcToPlc / PlcToNc), e.g. MAIN.axis or GVL_Motion.arAxis[1].

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path when the solution has more than one PLC project.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the planned links. false: back up, link, read back.

tools.name: AddTcComModule
tools.description: Creates a TcCOM module instance below 'TIRC^TcCOM Objects' from its class GUID or type name and returns the name XAE actually gave it. Dry-run by default.

ClassId.description: Class GUID from the TMC (<Module GUID=...>), with or without braces.

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report the plan. false: create and read back.

tools.name: GetTcComParameter
tools.description: Reads TcCOM module parameters: without -Name / -ParameterId the list from the ProduceXml; with one, its value via GetModulePara (offline) or GetOnlineModulePara (-Online).

Module.description: Instance name or tree path (TIRC^TcCOM Objects^<name> (<type>)).

ParameterId.description: Parameter id (PTCID) as '#x03150105', '0x03150105' or decimal, instead of -Name.

Online.description: Read the value of the running object on the target (needs Activate + Run) instead of the project value.

tools.name: SetTcComParameter
tools.description: Writes one TcCOM module parameter (SetModulePara into the project, or SetOnlineModulePara with -Online into the running object only) and reads it back. Dry-run by default.

Module.description: Instance name or tree path (TIRC^TcCOM Objects^<name> (<type>)).

ParameterId.description: Parameter id (PTCID) as '#x03150105', '0x03150105' or decimal, instead of -Name.

Value.description: New value: number (invariant culture, '.' as decimal separator), true / false for BOOL, text for STRING, milliseconds or a literal such as T#5S for TIME.

Online.description: Write the running object on the target only (needs Activate + Run); the project is not changed.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the planned bytes. false: back up, write, read back.

tools.name: SetTcComContext
tools.description: Assigns a task to a context of a TcCOM module (SetModuleContext with the TMC Context Id, not 0) and reads it back. Dry-run by default.

Module.description: Instance name or tree path (TIRC^TcCOM Objects^<name> (<type>)).

Task.description: Tree path of the task, e.g. TIRT^PlcTask or TINC^NC-Task 1 SAF.

ContextId.description: TMC Context Id; default (-1): the only context of the module.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the plan. false: back up, set, read back.

tools.name: GetVariants
tools.description: Reads the project variants (CurrentProjectVariant, ProjectVariantConfig, ProjectVariantItems): current, variants[], groups[].

tools.name: SetVariantConfig
tools.description: Adds or removes project variants: reads ProjectVariantConfig, changes it, writes the WHOLE document back and reads it back. Dry-run by default.

Group.description: Optional group the added variants join (created when missing).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the new document. false: back up, write, read back.

tools.name: SwitchVariant
tools.description: Switches the current project variant (CurrentProjectVariant; case-sensitive, '[Group]' allowed but not activatable, '' clears it) and reads it back. Dry-run by default.

Name.description: Variant name (exact case), '[<group>]', or '' to clear.

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report. false: back up, switch, read back.

tools.name: SetIndependentFile
tools.description: Turns "Independent Project File" (ITcSmTreeItem6.SaveInOwnFile) of a tree item on or off, saves the project and checks the .xti on disk. Dry-run by default.

Path.description: Full tree path, e.g. 'TIPC^MyPlc', 'TINC^NC-Task 1 SAF^Axes^Axis 1', 'TIRC^TcCOM Objects^<name> (<type>)'.

Enabled.description: true = store the item in its own .xti, false = back into the parent file.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the plan. false: back up, set, save, check the disk.

tools.name: GetAdsRoutes
tools.description: Lists the ADS routes of the CURRENT target from the TIRR ProduceXml: actual, static and project routes.

tools.name: FindAdsTargets
tools.description: Searches the network for ADS targets (TIRR BroadcastSearch, or Search for one IP / host name); only works when the IDE target is the local system.

Search.description: Optional IPv4 address or host name to ask directly; empty = broadcast search.

tools.name: AddAdsRoute
tools.description: NOT MEASURED (no second target was available; only unit tests): add an ADS route to a remote system (TIRR ConsumeXml AddRoute: Name, NetId, Address (IPv4) or HostName, UserName, LocalName) or, with ProjectRoute=true, only a project route (AddProjectRoute, no credentials). Dry-run by default.

NetId.description: AmsNetId of the remote system, e.g. 5.1.2.3.1.1.

Address.description: IPv4 address of the remote system.

HostName.description: Host name of the remote system.

UserName.description: User on the remote system (AddRoute only).

PasswordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable (Process scope) that holds the password, TCAUTO_ROUTE_PW or TCAUTO_ROUTE_PW_<SUFFIX> (AddRoute only); the value is never returned.

LocalName.description: Optional name of this system in the remote route table (AddRoute LocalName).

ProjectRoute.description: Add only a project route (AddProjectRoute, no credentials, nothing sent to the remote system).

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report. false: back up, send, read back.

tools.name: LookupTreeItem
tools.description: Generic tree tool, read-only: look up ONE tree item by its full path (ITcSysManager.LookupTreeItem, TE1000 v1.7.0 5.1.1.3) and return name, itemType, subType, subTypeName, type, childCount and children[] (name, path, itemType, subType, type).

Path.description: Full tree path, e.g. "TIRT^PlcTask" or "TIPC^MyPlc^MyPlc Project^POUs".

MaxChildren.description: Maximum number of children listed (1-1000, default 200).

tools.name: ProduceXml
tools.description: Generic tree tool, read-only: return the XML description of one tree item (ITcSmTreeItem.ProduceXml, TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.8; root element TreeItem) in data.xml.

Recursive.description: Passed as bRecursive to ProduceXml (default false).

tools.name: CreateChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool that CHANGES the configuration: create a child below Path (ITcSmTreeItem.CreateChild(Name, SubType, Before, VInfo), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.2). Dry-run by default.

Path.description: Full tree path of the PARENT, e.g. "TIRT".

Before.description: Optional name of an existing child before which the new one is inserted (bstrBefore).

VInfo.description: Optional vInfo of CreateChild (string or array, depends on the parent), e.g. "BOOL" for a process image variable, or "EK1100-0000-0017" for an EtherCAT box.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the plan. false: back up the parent, create, read back.

tools.name: ConsumeXml
tools.description: Generic tree tool that CHANGES the configuration: write an XML fragment into one tree item (ITcSmTreeItem.ConsumeXml, TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.1). Dry-run by default.

Path.description: Full tree path of the item to change, e.g. "TIRT^PlcTask".

Xml.description: The fragment: root <TreeItem>, only the elements to change, no attributes.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the planned change. false: back up, write, read back.

tools.name: DeleteChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool that DELETES configuration: delete the tree item at Path (its parent ITcSmTreeItem.DeleteChild(name), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.3). Dry-run by default.

Path.description: Full tree path of the item to delete, e.g. "TIRT^Task 2".

ConfirmName.description: Must equal the name of the item (the last path segment as XAE reports it), e.g. "Task 2".

DryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be deleted. false: back up, delete, read back.

AllowNoExport.description: true = delete even when the ExportChild backup (.xti, .zip below TIPC) failed or was not written (only the recursive ProduceXml backup remains, ImportChild cannot restore it; data.warnings says so).

tools.name: ExportChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool: export the tree item at Path with its subtree to an .xti file (parent ITcSmTreeItem.ExportChild(name, FilePath), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.4).

Path.description: Full tree path of the item to export, e.g. "TIRT^PlcTask".

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the file to write: .xti, or .zip for a PLC folder below TIPC (measured 2026-10-30 4026 VS2022 on a PLC folder only; other TIPC nodes not measured).

tools.name: ImportChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool that CHANGES the configuration: import an .xti / XML file as a child of Path (ITcSmTreeItem.ImportChild(FilePath, Before, Reconnect, Name), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.6; templates 6.3.2). Dry-run by default.

Path.description: Full tree path of the PARENT, e.g. "TIRT" or "TIID".

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the .xti / XML file to import; .zip for a PLC folder below TIPC (measured 2026-10-30 4026 VS2022 on a PLC folder only; other TIPC nodes not measured).

Before.description: Optional name of an existing child before which the item is inserted (bstrBefore).

Reconnect.description: bReconnect (default true): re-establish existing mapping information.

Name.description: Optional new name of the imported item (bstrName); empty keeps the name from the file (data.expectedName, checked for an existing child).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the plan. false: back up the parent, import, read back.

tools.name: BuildProject
tools.description: Build the PLC project of the open solution and wait for the result.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the build to finish (BuildState = Done); BUILD_TIMEOUT after that.

ExpectedProject.description: PLC project name(s) that must be compiled, e.g. ["FrameworkUnitTest"] (the .plcproj file name without extension).

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Accept a build whose Error List shows unresolved libraries as success (data.warningCode=LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, codeVerified=false) instead of returning LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED.

tools.name: CleanProject
tools.description: Clean the open solution (Build > Clean Solution) and wait until SolutionBuild.BuildState is Done (TimeoutSec default 300 -> CLEAN_TIMEOUT).

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds for the clean (BuildState = Done).

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Accept a clean whose only errors are unresolved libraries ('<plc>.Library Manager'): success with data.warningCode = LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED and data.cleanVerified = $false instead of the LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED error.

tools.name: CheckAllObjects
tools.description: Checks the syntax of EVERY object of the PLC project (ITcPlcIECProject2.CheckAllObjects), also the ones no build compiles; returns the Error List rows like BuildProject.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: GenerateBootProject
tools.description: Generates the local boot project of a PLC (GenerateBootProject($false) on 'TIPC^<Plc>'): writes _Boot\<platform>\Plc\Port_<port>.* of the project, not the target.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>' or 'TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: GetBuildErrors
tools.description: Read the compiler messages currently shown in the XAE Error List: data.counts {errors, warnings, messages}, data.errors[] and data.warnings[] (IncludeWarnings defaults to true; IncludeWarnings=false skips the warning toggle and saves 1-2 s); IncludeMessages=true adds data.messages[].

IncludeWarnings.description: Default on; -IncludeWarnings:$false skips the warning toggle (saves 1-2 s of UIA).

TimeoutSec.description: Hard limit for the UI Automation scan, including the one-time preparation of its helper types (the first call in a process; the scan gets what is left, at least 1 s).

tools.name: SetTarget
tools.description: Set the target AmsNetId (ITcSysManager.SetTargetNetId, always done first: data.amsNetId, data.targetSet=true even when the result is an error) and make the active solution platform follow the target.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID (e.g., "127.0.0.1.1.1" for local).

Platform.description: Solution platform to activate, e.g. 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' (Usermode Runtime / UmRT, TwinCAT/BSD) or 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' (Windows RT).

NoPlatformSwitch.description: true = only set the target NetId; never touch the solution platform and never return PLATFORM_UNKNOWN.

tools.name: EnableConfig
tools.description: Activate the configuration on the target without any dialog.

Force.description: true = full lifecycle without dialogs (Config -> Activate -> Run -> Login/Download -> PLC Run).

NoLogin.description: true = stop after TwinCAT reaches Run; skip PLC login/download/Run.

TimeoutSec.description: Overall time limit for the whole -Force cycle (single deadline).

NoPlatformFix.description: true = do not switch the solution platform; a mismatch with the target (or Platform) platform returns PLATFORM_MISMATCH before anything is activated.

Platform.description: Reference platform used only when the target does not report one through TARGETINFO (ADS 0x702): 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' for a Usermode Runtime / UmRT or TwinCAT/BSD, 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' for a Windows RT target.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC project(s) to log in and start, by name (["FrameworkUnitTest"]) or tree path.

ActivateTimeoutSec.description: Deadline in seconds for ActivateConfiguration() (default 180, also bounded by TimeoutSec with Force).

tools.name: SendPlcProgram
tools.description: Download the compiled PLC program to the target (alias of PlcLogin LoginMode=Download: Login+Download without dialogs).

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project.

tools.name: ConnectAds
tools.description: Open the ADS connection to the PLC runtime.

tools.name: DisconnectAds
tools.description: Close the ADS connection and forget the cached endpoint (disables auto-reconnect).

tools.name: ReadVariable
tools.description: Read one or more PLC variables by symbol path (e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter","GVL.bRun"]) via ADS.

Path.description: Array of PLC symbol paths, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"].

tools.name: WriteVariable
tools.description: Write a single PLC variable by symbol path via ADS.

Value.description: New value matching the PLC type of the symbol: JSON bool (BOOL), number (integer/REAL/LREAL), string (STRING).

tools.name: WatchVariable
tools.description: Poll one or more PLC variables (Path is an array; every round reads each path in order) every IntervalMs.

Path.description: One or more variable paths to monitor, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"] or ["MAIN.fActual","MAIN.bDone"].

IntervalMs.description: Delay between sampling rounds in milliseconds.

DurationMs.description: Sampling duration in ms when Until is not given (default 2000).

Until.description: Stop condition '<Path> <op> <value>' with op one of == != > < >= <=, e.g. 'MAIN.fTarget == 123.5'. <Path> must be in Path (case-insensitive).

UntilTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in ms to wait for Until before returning untilMet=false.

TimeoutMs.description: Legacy alias of UntilTimeoutMs; used only when UntilTimeoutMs is not given.

KeepLast.description: Number of most recent samples to return. 0 = auto (20 with Until, 50 without). sampleCount still counts every round; truncated=true when older samples were dropped.

tools.name: GetSymbols
tools.description: List the PLC symbols of the connected runtime, optionally filtered by a substring (Filter): data is an array (empty when nothing matches) of {path, type, size, comment}, plus enumValues (member name -> value) for enum types; the execution order is in the top-level order field.

tools.name: GetPlcState
tools.description: Read the PLC runtime state (Run/Stop/...) on the connected ADS port.

tools.name: SetPlcState
tools.description: Switch the PLC runtime to Run, Stop or Reset and wait for the state.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum wait for Run/Stop to be reached.

tools.name: PlcLogin
tools.description: Login to the PLC project and download the program in one call (PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS Regular, prompts answered by SilentMode, no dialogs).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project).

LoginMode.description: Regular (default): PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS_REGULAR - login, download only when the runtime has no program (XAE decides).

SilentFlag.description: OR PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS_SILENT (256) into the login flags.

TimeoutSec.description: Expected upper bound of the Login COM call (Invoke-TcComRetry -TimeoutSec), default 300.

tools.name: PlcLogout
tools.description: Log out of the PLC project (the runtime keeps running).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project).

tools.name: GetSystemState
tools.description: Read the TwinCAT system state (Run/Config) of a target over ADS port 10000.

tools.name: SetSystemState
tools.description: Switch TwinCAT to Run or Config via ADS WriteControl (no StartRestartTwinCAT dialog) and poll until the state is reached.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time to wait for the target state.

SettleSec.description: Seconds the reached state must hold before success (sampled every 250 ms, then read back).

tools.name: ClearLifecycleBlock
tools.description: Remove the LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED record of one target (#68).

tools.name: ReportIssue
tools.description: Build a de-identified, pre-filled GitHub new-issue URL (and the same title / body as text) for a problem found while using this server; it creates NOTHING, calls no GitHub API and no network, needs no token and no IDE / ADS connection (works while the IDE is blocked by a modal dialog and is not r...

Title.description: One-line summary of the problem (becomes the issue title, 120 characters at most).

Tool.description: Name of the MCP tool or cmdlet that was called, e.g. 'BuildProject' or 'Enable-TcConfig'.

Parameters.description: The parameters of that call: an object, or a JSON string.

Result.description: The failing result: the {success, error, data} object returned by the tool, or its JSON string. error.hint is dropped.

Expected.description: What you expected to happen instead.

Notes.description: Anything else: steps before the call, TwinCAT / XAE version and target kind (UmRT, CX ...), what was tried.

MaxUrlLength.description: Upper limit of the encoded URL in characters, 2000..8000.

ExtraMask.description: Literal strings (customer, site, plant, person names) to replace with <redacted> everywhere.

IncludeSolutionName.description: Put the solution file name of the connected IDE into the Environment section (left out by default).

tools.name: NewTestCase
tools.description: Build a test case object for RunTest/RunTestCycle.

Setup.description: Writes before the test: array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":1} (keys Path = PLC symbol path, Value = value to write, converted to the PLC type).

Teardown.description: Writes after the test (also run when the test fails): array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":0} (keys Path, Value).

WaitUntil.description: Conditions to poll before the assertions (replaces WaitMs): array of {"Path":"MAIN.bDone","Operator":"IsTrue"} (same keys and Operator set as Assertions; Expected omitted for IsTrue/IsFalse).

WaitTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in ms to poll WaitUntil (1..600000, default 5000).

WaitMs.description: DEPRECATED: fixed blind wait in ms before the assertions (default 1000), ignored when WaitUntil is given.

Assertions.description: Checks after WaitUntil (or the deprecated WaitMs): array of {"Path":"MAIN.y","Operator":"Equal","Expected":1}.

tools.name: RunTest
tools.description: Execute one test case created with NewTestCase (setup writes -> wait -> assertions -> teardown writes) against the connected PLC.

TestCase.description: A test case object as returned by NewTestCase.

tools.name: RunTestCycle
tools.description: Builds, activates (TwinCAT restart) and runs the PLC: changes the running machine.

TestCases.description: Array of test case objects as returned by NewTestCase.

SkipBuild.description: Skip the build step (if already built).

KeepRunning.description: Don't stop the PLC after tests complete.

tools.name: ListOperations
tools.description: List all available operations.
